verdict_reason: Re-derived Facco et al. 2017's five-step Two-NN and checked BLME against the closed form: on EXACT Pareto(d) quantiles the OLS-through-origin fit returns d to rel 8.19e-05 for d in {2,5,10,20}. Finite-sample anchors on uniform hypercubes embedded in R^{d+20}: 2.0132 / 4.7584 / 8.9966 for true d = 2 / 5 / 10 at N = 4000 / 8000 / 20000, matching scikit-dimension 0.3.4's own 2.013 / 4.750 / 8.769 to rel 1.6e-03 and 6.6e-04 (the difference is exactly the one-based vs zero-based empirical CDF, and BLME's F_i = i/N is the one Facco step 4 specifies). The layerwise branch now hooks the deepest block on both routes; measured on the study config (num_samples=200, 23,272 rows subsampled to 20,000, seed 42) gpt2 lid_layer_11 9.364225 -> 7.397301 and distilgpt2 lid_layer_5 8.890688 -> 7.465446.
comparable_reason: The emitted columns are lid_layer_<ABSOLUTE INDEX>. Across the 66 archived models that is 64 distinct column names, of which only 6 (lid_layer_0..5) cover 100% of models, and 18 of them ALIAS MORE THAN ONE DEPTH ROLE -- lid_layer_11 is the deepest layer for a 12-layer model and an interior layer for anything deeper. A regression on those columns fits two different quantities to one coefficient. On top of that the values themselves track architecture: archive Spearman lid_layer_0 +0.225 (d_model) / +0.126 (n_layers) / +0.246 (log params), lid_layer_5 -0.132 / -0.386 / -0.218.

paper_reason: Facco et al. 2017's defining relation log(1-F(mu)) = -d log(mu) is a closed form. Feeding exact Pareto(d) quantiles to _twonn_linear_fit returns 2.000164 / 5.000409 / 10.000819 / 20.001638 for d = 2 / 5 / 10 / 20 -- rel 8.19e-05, the residual being the i/N vs (i-0.5)/N convention.
confounds_reason: Archive Spearman: lid_layer_0 +0.225 d_model / +0.126 n_layers / +0.183 log vocab / +0.246 log params; lid_layer_5 -0.132 / -0.386 / -0.291 / -0.218. More decisively, the column NAMES are architecture-indexed: 18 of the 64 emitted names mean different depths for different models, so the feature matrix mixes roles before any correlation is computed.
